step.label: Analyze Engineering Change Impact and Workforce Readiness
step.description: Evaluate production transition requirements and identify skill gaps needed for successful change implementation.
step.useCase: Plant managers need to understand which workforce skills are required before deploying engineering changes to production.

step.label: Validate Material and Equipment Specifications
step.description: Retrieve and verify material definitions and vendor specifications impacted by the engineering change.
step.useCase: Supply chain teams need confirmed material specs before authorizing equipment modifications.

step.label: Assess Equipment Service Readiness and Dependencies
step.description: Evaluate current equipment state, service requirements, and cascading change dependencies across the production line.
step.useCase: Maintenance teams need to know equipment service status and change dependencies before deployment.

step.label: Orchestrate Asset Provisioning for Transition
step.description: Coordinate allocation and provisioning of materials, equipment, and product items needed to support the production transition.
step.useCase: Operations directors need automated coordination of all physical assets required for the change rollout.

step.label: Grant Workforce Access Permissions and Credentials
step.description: Provision system access, security credentials, and role-based permissions for transitioned workforce members.
step.useCase: HR and IT teams need to ensure workers have proper system access before production handoff.

step.label: Automate Change Execution and Workflow Orchestration
step.description: Execute automated workflows and change procedures across systems to implement the production transition safely.
step.useCase: Operations teams need reliable, repeatable automation to minimize manual errors during complex transitions.

step.label: Segment and Engage Customer Contacts on Transition Impact
step.description: Identify affected customer segments and deploy targeted communications about production changes and timeline impacts.
step.useCase: Marketing teams need to proactively inform customers about product or service availability changes.

step.label: Update Customer Engagement Profiles with Transition Status
step.description: Record customer account profiles with current transition status, affected orders, and fulfillment timeline adjustments.
step.useCase: Customer success teams need real-time visibility into how each account is affected by production transitions.
